proof: Normative runtime requirements; schema tests do not execute these state transitions.

scenarios.name: billing-to-two-channels

steps.action: prepare Telegram and email deliveries for current verified recipient

scenarios.expected: Email and Telegram have independent Delivery; one Notification; payment and access unchanged by channel failure.

scenarios.name: material-to-two-channels

steps.action: snapshot opted-in eligible audience at event time and current access

scenarios.expected: One Notification per publication occurrence and Account; distinct channel deliveries; no protected body or access token.

scenarios.name: outbox-confirm-loss

steps.action: commit source+outbox; broker persists; confirm lost; restart relay

scenarios.expected: Replay same messageId; one receipt and one notification per recipient.

scenarios.name: inbox-ack-loss

steps.action: commit inbox; lose ack; redeliver

scenarios.expected: Existing payload matches; ack and resume durable job; do not create another delivery.

scenarios.name: payload-conflict

steps.action: reuse messageId or operationId with altered text/binding

scenarios.expected: Durable conflict/quarantine; no current payload overwritten and no send.

scenarios.name: publisher-authority

steps.action: Telegram principal publishes billing event or sender selects another channel result

scenarios.expected: Broker ACL rejects; body field cannot authenticate publisher; no receipt creates authority.

scenarios.name: freshness

steps.action: cancel reminder or unpublish material before authorize

scenarios.expected: Denied/suppressed; no send; payment and publication facts unchanged.

scenarios.name: access-and-opt-out

steps.action: disable material channel or revoke access after audience expansion before authorize

scenarios.expected: Denied; no service-purpose fallback; late opt-in does not backfill.

scenarios.name: link-race

steps.action: unlink or replace verified binding before authorize

scenarios.expected: Binding conflict suppresses old recipient; never auto-retarget unknown or sent notification.

scenarios.name: unknown-send

steps.action: commit started; provider may accept; lose response; expire lease; acquire new permit

scenarios.expected: Unknown persists; no automatic second send across workers, revisions, restart or channel rebinding.

scenarios.name: late-success

steps.action: record unknown; later receive verified success for same attempt; old result arrives last

scenarios.expected: Source ledger advances to sent; higher resultRevision wins; old/different attempt cannot overwrite; no resend.

scenarios.name: result-outage

steps.action: commit sent+result outbox; RabbitMQ unavailable; caller sees accepted

scenarios.expected: Result outbox retries; replay original command returns evidence; status lag never sends again.

scenarios.name: permit-expiry

steps.action: allowed permit expires before started

scenarios.expected: No I/O; new authorize ID/attempt may permit first send only while ledger not_started and command valid.

scenarios.name: command-refresh

steps.action: command deadline expires without started; producer asks to refresh revision

scenarios.expected: Receiver must prove no started attempt under Delivery lock before accepting higher revision; old queued revision suppressed.

scenarios.name: definitive-rejection

steps.action: Bot API returns known 429; persist not_sent; retry_after passes

scenarios.expected: Same Delivery, new attempt with fresh permit; shared bot capacity defers all send paths; within deadline.

scenarios.name: audience-restart

steps.action: crash during material audience expansion; account opts in after publication

scenarios.expected: Checkpoint resumes bounded batches; uniqueness prevents duplicates; later opt-in/account creation excluded.

scenarios.name: material-republication

steps.action: edit published material; unpublish and republish; add same Material to Series

scenarios.expected: No new first-publication occurrence or automatic second announcement.

scenarios.name: backlog-expiry

steps.action: RabbitMQ unavailable past command deadline or 24h material event lifetime

scenarios.expected: Expired command suppressed; source may issue safe refreshed revision only if current and proven not_started; old material event suppressed.

scenarios.name: fairness

steps.action: large material audience and existing broadcast while billing commands arrive continuously

scenarios.expected: Separate bounded lanes reserve service capacity and nonzero content share under shared bot/chat limits.

scenarios.name: poison-and-overflow

steps.action: invalid version enters queue or max length reached

scenarios.expected: Quarantine durably before poison ack; no requeue loop; reject-publish retains producer outbox and alerts.

scenarios.name: community-separate

steps.action: notification disabled while a finite community grant expires

scenarios.expected: Community reconciliation still enforces expiry; notification state does not grant/revoke access.

scenarios.name: provider-offline

steps.action: Platform authorize unavailable or provider blocked

scenarios.expected: No I/O without permit; bounded retries to deadline or failed unreachable recipient; no change to billing/access.
